selection.rationale: With no prior strategy-local MACE optimization outcomes, we execute a balanced initial exploration across the entire allow-listed design space (32 black-phosphorene and 32 blue-phosphorene structures across all five size tiers: 4, 16, 36, 64, and 144). All single-capacity pristine baselines and 4-atom reconstruction actions are sampled once to establish reference geometries and energies, while the remaining budget is distributed symmetrically across in-plane strain (0.02) and supercell reconstruction perturbations (2 counts each at tier 4 strain; 3 counts each across tiers 16, 36, 64, and 144 for both strain and reconstruction) to empirically evaluate post-relaxation survival and symmetry-aware deduplication yields across perturbations and supercell sizes.
